newsitem.title: USA: AMEX, PCX to list Hambrecht & Quist options.
newsitem.headline: AMEX, PCX to list Hambrecht & Quist options.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) and the Pacific Exchange (PSE) said they will list options on Hambrecht & Quist Inc shares on August 12.
The options will have initial strike prices of 25, 30 and 35, with expirations in September, October, November and February. Position limits are 4,500 contracts.
The specialist on the AMEX floor will be Cohen, Duffy & McGowan Inc, while Paul Mandell and Megan Trainer of Susquehanna Investment Group will be the lead market makers on PCX, the exchanges said.
